description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android widget extending TextView that implements the LogNode interface. It is used to display log messages received via the println method, formatting log level, tag, message, and exception details. The class also manages a chain of LogNode objects, allowing it to pass log messages along a chain for further processing.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView widget that implements LogNode, used to display log messages in the UI and chain log output.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message, including its priority, tag, message, and throwable, then updates the UI and forwards the log to the next node if available.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.
